in_hebrew.name: שרליין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew word ‘שר’ (shir), meaning ‘song’ or ‘poem’, and ‘לין’ (line), meaning ‘bird’. The name Shirline could be interpreted as ‘singing bird’.

in_greek.name: Σιρλίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: Although there is no direct Greek equivalent for the name Shirline, it can be interpreted as ‘shining light’ from the English meaning of ‘shining’ and the Greek word ‘λίνος’ (linos), meaning ‘light’ or ‘torch’.

in_latin.name: Cantilina
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin name derived from ‘cantare’ (to sing), and ‘linus’ (song), thus meaning ‘singing song’.
